t: The 4lite Yuto fixed fire rated LED downlight is a high-performance recessed ceiling light designed for reliable illumination. This satin chrome IP65-rated fitting is ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and retail spaces. This light offers tool-free installation, featuring push-fit terminals and a transparent connector cover for quick visual checks. The integrated 5W LED delivers 630 lumens with a 4 colour temperature options from 2700K to 6000K, allowing easy adjustment. Fully dimmable and fire-rated for 30, 60 and 90 minutes, this durable downlight offers a 60,000 hour lifespan. Includes paintable twist-on bezel.
